messages:
incident-bot: P0 alert — High error rate and latency for Private deployments in azure-polandcentral. Metrics: 10x 5xxs on private endpoints, BGP flaps observed on ExpressRoute private peering. Pager -> oncall-network, oncall-sre.

oncall-network: I'm on it. Pulling BGP state and CSRs. Any affected tenant IDs yet?

maya: seeing customer-facing 502/504s from Private nodes in polandcentral; Dedicated clusters ok in westeurope. Traffic to polandcentral control-plane is timing out.

kai: I can see BGP withdraws from Azure side around 12:02 UTC and repeated re-announces. Looks like route oscillation to on-prem prefixes.

nick: Support report — 3 customers on Private with active on-prem circuits reported intermittent connectivity and failing API calls. Customer A sees steady 200ms+ latencies then 5xx.

lina: CS drafting incident notification. If we need planned failover we need ETA for routing fix.

kai: Opening Azure support ticket + escalation. azure-support-bot, please confirm any known platform maintenance in polandcentral.

azure-support-bot: Microsoft Azure incident/search: No platform maintenance scheduled for polandcentral. Ticket created #AZ-88123 and engineer assigned.

maya: Quick mitigation options: 1) BGP community rewrite at our edge to prefer alternate egress to westeurope; 2) temporarily advertise narrower prefixes to discourage unstable path; 3) instruct customers to failover to dedicated/westeurope endpoints (requires updating DNS or route maps). Thoughts?

oncall-sre: We should avoid DNS churn for customers. Prefer routing-level mitigations first. Kai, can we add a static route on our PE to prefer the stable path?

kai: I can push a local-export policy to prefer peer B until Azure sorts the flaps. Pushing now (will apply to all Private circuits in polandcentral).

kai: Applied policy -> export-prefer-stable-peer. Monitoring BGP:
```
BGP neighbor 10.1.5.2: Established
Prefixes Received: 1,234
Flaps last 15m: 0 (after policy)
```

maya: After policy application error rate dropped from 12% -> 2% over 5m window. Latency trending down. Customer A confirms fewer errors.

nick: Notifying impacted customers: Customer A and B notified with mitigation steps and status. Lina sent initial message and provisional ETA.

lina: Sent update: "We're seeing intermittent network instability in Azure polandcentral affecting private connectivity. Our engineers have implemented a temporary routing policy to mitigate impact; we'll follow up with full RCA." :email:

incident-bot: Incident status -> mitigation in progress. Severity remains P0 until stable for 30 minutes.

oncall-network: Azure assigned engineer says they observed an internal route-reflector instability causing BGP churn on our peering VLAN. They're rolling a targeted fix to the control plane now. Asking for logs from our side.

kai: Uploaded BGP/if counters and pcap to case. Also captured sample of withdrawn prefixes with timestamps.

maya: Running quick smoke across private clusters; small percentage of RPCs still erroring but falling. Keeping canary traffic for 15m.

nick: Customers asked whether we can failover them to westeurope for the rest of the day. Some have compliance constraints requiring private peering — need explicit opt-in.

oncall-sre: For customers without strict on-prem requirements, we can offer temporary DNS re-point to westeurope-managed endpoints. Coordinate with CS for consent.

lina: Tracking acceptances in the support ticket. Two customers agreed to temporary failover, one declined due to latency/SLA requirements.

incident-bot: Update logged -> azure-support-bot case AZ-88123 updated with root-cause candidates and our mitigation steps.

kai: Azure confirms fix deployed to their route-reflector cluster at 12:28 UTC. They've stopped observing BGP flap events. We're seeing steady announce state.

maya: Error rate now at 0.6% over 10m and latency back to baseline for most flows. Keeping P0 for monitoring and RCA.

oncall-network: Preparing runbook entry for transient RR instability and our edge policy to prefer alternate egress as an automated fallback.

lina: Sending customer follow-up: summarizing impact, steps taken, and next steps for RCA.

maya: Quick postmortem notes — timeline, mitigation (edge policy applied), customer communications, and action items: automate edge policy when Azure-side BGP flap detected, add BGP flap alert to perf dashboards, coordinate with Azure for proactive notification on RR maintenance.

nick: Closing loop with customers who opted in for failover. Confirmed two returned to baseline after routing change.

incident-bot: Incident transitioned to 'mitigated' at 12:45 UTC; monitoring window until 13:15 UTC.

maya: Assigning owners: kai -> network RCA + runbook; maya -> impact timeline and metrics; lina -> customer closure notes; nick -> support ticket follow-ups.

oncall-sre: Handoff acknowledged. If anything regresses, page oncall-network immediately.

lina: Final customer summary queued for 13:30 UTC with RCA to follow once full logs from Azure are in. :white_check_mark:
